source: Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026: azure, aws, hoster, ai_usage, ai_subscriptions, saas
calculation_or_assumption: Sum of all cost rows Sep 2025-Aug 2026 after removing exact duplicates and Draft rows; missing costs imputed from median unit price; EUR/USD converted with monthly ECB-based rates in exchange_rates.csv; Azure SLA credits kept as negative cost; bonus invoices (ai_invoice_monthly, provider report) used only as cross-checks to avoid double counting.

value_mid: 1) Department named in the row (cloud tags; consuming department in the AI gateway); 2) else cost centre of the row (licences, hoster); 3) else mapping_departments_tools.csv by resource_id; 4) anything still on Overhead (9000) by monthly FTE share from headcount.csv; test account (9100, sandboxes) 100% to IT.
